For s≠t, over Q(zeta_m), the q-th cyclotomic minimal polynomial forces level-set Fourier coefficients either all equal or, by zero sum, all zero when the fiber frequency difference is nonzero. Thus g is constant on cosets of the subgroup generated by nonzero Fourier support, exactly P_f^perp by finite Fourier inversion, yielding q^{|P_f|} spectra. For each divisor e|m the functions fixed by the unique subgroup of order e number q^{m/e}; Möbius inversion gives H_{m,q}(d)=sum_{e multiple d} mu(e/d)q^{m/e}. Independently enumerated ALL graph functions and ALL literal ambient m-element frequency sets with direct complex character sums in coprime instances (m,q)=(2,3),(3,2),(2,5),(3,5),(4,3), matching predicted strata (e.g. (4,3): 72 functions with 3 spectra, 6 with 9, 3 with 81). No extrapolation from finite enumeration is used. Boundary m=1 gives q spectra; q is prime and gcd(m,q)=1 is essential.
